requirement.original: Session recovery should be event-driven, not count-based. Server reboot? Restore all. OOM? Respawn that session. Archive? Don't respawn. The watcher auto-restore is the source of all cascade bugs.
requirement.clarified: Move single-session crash recovery to the daemon (onChildExited with exit code inspection), remove watcher auto-restore trigger, fix remaining bash bugs (#3-#5), keep ExecStartPost for daemon restart path.
requirement.what: Event-driven session recovery: daemon respawns crashed sessions, watcher becomes passive observer
requirement.why: Count-based watcher auto-restore cannot distinguish crash from archive, causing cascade bugs (Bug #62) where archived sessions get resurrected

included: Daemon onChildExited respawn logic with exit code inspection
Remove watcher auto-restore trigger from watch_sessions()
Fix qijie home_dir empty string convention
excluded: ExecStartPost restore logic (keep as-is for daemon restart path)
Watcher snapshot writing mechanism (only remove the restore trigger)

success_criteria: OOM-killed session (exit 137) is respawned by daemon within 5 seconds
stopSession SIGTERM is NOT treated as crash requiring respawn
Watcher never calls restore_online_sessions on count drop
ExecStartPost still restores sessions on daemon restart
find_peak_snapshot searches all HAPPY_HOMES, not just first
read_snapshot_count aggregates across all homes or scopes to SCOPE_HOME
Default daemon uses explicit /root/.happy in session_dirs.txt, not empty string
constraints: Must not break ExecStartPost daemon restart recovery path
Must handle sessions that crash before webhook (no claudeSessionId yet = no respawn)
Must distinguish daemon-initiated SIGTERM (stopSession) from external SIGTERM
Respawn must use existing spawnSession() with resumeSessionId parameter
Max 3 respawn attempts with exponential backoff to prevent loops

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Archived sessions get resurrected; watcher auto-restore triggers cascading restores that interfere with daemon-managed sessions; qijie archiving all sessions triggers a zero-drop peak merge that restores everything
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The watcher uses count-based heuristics to detect 'disappeared' sessions and triggers auto-restore, but it CANNOT distinguish between crash (should restore) and archive (should NOT restore). The exit code information exists only in the daemon's process handler, not in the watcher's process scan.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural design flaw, not a single commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The watcher was designed as a safety net to detect OOM kills and crashes, but count-based detection is fundamentally unable to determine exit intent
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: 1) Archive looks identical to crash from watcher's perspective (both reduce count). 2) Peak merge on zero-drop resurrects intentionally archived sessions. 3) Watcher and ExecStartPost race to restore, causing duplicate spawns.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Ongoing since watcher auto-restore was added; became acute with Bug #62 when qijie's sessions were repeatedly resurrected after archival

daemon_onChildExited.summary: Currently only notifies server of session end and removes from tracking. Does NOT inspect exit code. Does NOT attempt respawn.

daemon_processExitHandler.summary: happyProcess.on('exit', (code, signal) => { ... onChildExited(pid) }). Exit code and signal are available but NOT passed to onChildExited.

daemon_stopSession.summary: Sends SIGTERM to process. Does NOT mark session as 'stopping by daemon', so SIGTERM exit would look like a crash.

trackedSessionType.summary: Has pid, childProcess, happySessionId, tmuxSessionId. Missing: workingDirectory, claudeSessionId, stoppingByDaemon flag.

spawnSessionOptions.summary: Already has resumeSessionId field for --resume support. directory field provides working dir.

watcherAutoRestore.summary: if [ $nr -gt 0 ]; then restore_online_sessions & fi — THIS IS THE LINE TO REMOVE

findPeakSnapshot.summary: Has 'break' on line 391 that stops after first home. Bug: only checks /root/.happy snapshots.

readSnapshotCount.summary: Returns count from first home's session_dirs.txt. Bug: ignores other homes.

killThisHappyExitCode.summary: cleanup() calls process.exit(0) on success, process.exit(1) on error. killSession RPC triggers cleanup -> exit(0).

claudeRemoteLauncherCrashHandling.summary: Inner while loop handles Claude SDK crashes (up to MAX_CONSECUTIVE_CRASHES=5). After 5 crashes, sets exitReason='exit' and the process exits cleanly. Daemon-level respawn handles the PROCESS dying, not Claude SDK crashes.

development_approach.strategy: Two-pronged: (1) Add respawn logic to daemon TypeScript, (2) Simplify bash watcher by removing auto-restore trigger and fixing remaining bugs

changes: Pass exit code and signal to onChildExited: onChildExited(pid, code, signal)
In happyProcess.on('exit') handler (line 558): pass code and signal to onChildExited
In onChildExited: inspect code/signal, if non-zero AND session has claudeSessionId AND NOT stoppingByDaemon -> schedule respawn via spawnSession()
Store workingDirectory in TrackedSession when creating it in spawnSession() (from options.directory)
Store claudeSessionId in TrackedSession when metadata webhook arrives (from sessionMetadata.claudeSessionId)
In stopSession(): set session.stoppingByDaemon = true before sending SIGTERM
Add respawn backoff: 5s delay, max 3 attempts, track via respawnCount on TrackedSession
In heartbeat prune loop (line 736): also clean up respawnCount for dead sessions
Remove auto-restore trigger in watch_sessions() (lines 643-649): delete the if [ $nr -gt 0 ] block, keep the log line
Fix find_peak_snapshot(): remove 'break' on line 391 so all homes are searched
Fix read_snapshot_count(): aggregate across all homes (sum counts) or scope to SCOPE_HOME when set
Fix scan_running_sessions(): emit explicit /root/.happy for default daemon instead of empty string for home_dir

development_approach.validation_approach: 1) Unit: verify onChildExited respawn logic with mocked exit codes (0 = no respawn, 137 = respawn, stoppingByDaemon = no respawn). 2) Integration: spawn a session, kill -9 it, verify daemon respawns. 3) Integration: archive a session, verify daemon does NOT respawn. 4) Bash: verify watcher logs count changes but never calls restore_online_sessions. 5) Bash: verify find_peak_snapshot searches all homes.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward architecture change with clear root cause and well-understood patterns (process exit code inspection, event-driven vs polling). No external research needed.
